name: IP Calculator
description: IPv4 / IPv6 subnet calculator: network, broadcast, host range, subnetting and range to CIDR
help: Enter an address with a prefix (192.168.1.10/24), a netmask (10.0.0.1 255.0.0.0) or just an address.
Split a network into smaller subnets, check whether an address belongs to it, or turn any address range into the minimal list of CIDR blocks.
/31 and /32 IPv4 networks follow RFC 3021: every address is usable.
All calculations run locally in Rust.

details.title: Details
details.empty: Enter an IP address or network

contains.placeholder: Check whether an address is in this network

split.title: Split into subnets
split.hint: Turn on to split the network into smaller subnets with a longer prefix.

range.hint: Converts any address range into the smallest set of CIDR blocks that covers it exactly.
